process.heading: From brief to signed offer in four steps
process.intro: A search that drags on costs you more than a fee ever will. Here's how we keep it moving.

steps.heading: Intake call
steps.body: 45 minutes on the role, the team, and what "great" looks like — not just the job description.

steps.heading: Search & screen
steps.body: We approach people directly, interview every candidate, and check references early, not last.

steps.heading: Shortlist
steps.body: 3–5 vetted candidates within two weeks, each with our written assessment and salary expectations.

steps.heading: Offer & onboarding
steps.body: We handle negotiation and stay in touch through the first 90 days to make sure it sticks.

candidates_page.heading: How hiring works when you go through us
candidates_page.intro: Most agencies leave you guessing. This is exactly what happens from the moment you apply to the day you start — and what we commit to at every step.
candidates_page.steps_intro: Six steps, and you always know which one you are on.

steps.heading: You apply
steps.body: Apply to a role from our list, or send an open application if nothing fits yet. A CV is enough to start — no cover letter, no forms to fill in.

steps.heading: A real conversation
steps.body: A 30-minute call within three working days. We ask what you actually want next: the work, the salary, the commute, and the things you will not compromise on.

steps.heading: We ask before we send
steps.body: If a role fits, we tell you who the employer is and why we think it works. Your CV goes nowhere until you say yes to that specific company.

steps.heading: Interview, properly prepared
steps.body: You get the job description, who you will meet, how they interview and the salary range before you walk in. Nothing about the day should be a surprise.

steps.heading: Feedback within 48 hours
steps.body: After every interview, whichever way it went. If it is a no, you get the real reason — not that they went with someone else.

steps.heading: Offer, and your first 90 days
steps.body: We handle the negotiation, so you are never arguing about your own salary. Then we check in through your first three months.

promises: Real salary ranges on every role, before you apply
Honest feedback after every interview, within 48 hours
Your CV never shared without your explicit yes, company by company
Completely free — candidates never pay us anything
Confidential throughout, including from your current employer

faq.question: Does this cost me anything?
faq.answer: No, and it never will. The hiring company pays our fee. It makes no difference to your salary — it is not taken out of what you are offered.

faq.question: Will my current employer find out?
faq.answer: Not from us. We never send your CV anywhere without your explicit yes for that specific company, and you can name employers to exclude from any search on your behalf.

faq.question: What if I am not right for the role I applied to?
faq.answer: We tell you honestly and we say why. If something better suited is coming, we keep you in mind — with your permission, and not by adding you to a mailing list.

faq.question: How long does it usually take?
faq.answer: From first call to signed offer is typically three to six weeks, depending on how quickly the employer moves. We tell you their timeline at the start rather than leaving you waiting.

faq.question: What should my CV look like?
faq.answer: Plain and up to date is enough. If something needs strengthening before we send it, we tell you what and why — we do not quietly rewrite it behind your back.

faq.heading: Questions we hear before every search

items.question: What does a search cost, and when do we pay?
items.answer: Our fee is a percentage of the placed candidate's first-year salary, invoiced only when they sign. No upfront costs, no charge if we don't fill the role.

items.question: How long until we see candidates?
items.answer: You'll have a shortlist of 3–5 interviewed, reference-checked candidates within two weeks of the intake call for most roles. Niche or executive searches can take longer — we'll tell you honestly at the start.

items.question: What if the placement doesn't work out?
items.answer: Every placement comes with a replacement guarantee: if the person leaves within the guarantee period, we run the search again at no additional fee.

items.question: Do candidates pay anything?
items.answer: Never. Our services are completely free for candidates — the hiring company pays our fee.

items.question: Is the search confidential?
items.answer: Yes, on both sides. We can run fully confidential searches for sensitive replacements, and we never share a candidate's CV with anyone without their explicit consent.
